issue_request: FHIR-34356 was an Applied/Persuasive R5 Orders and Observations change request to add DeviceDefinition.regulatoryIdentifier as a 0..* BackboneElement for regulatory documentation identifiers such as EUDAMED Basic UDI-DI, master UDI-DI, and license identifiers, with type, identifier, issuer, and jurisdiction components.

additional_context: DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source still contains the 0..* regulatoryIdentifier backbone, the required type, identifier, issuer, and jurisdiction children, and the regulatory identifier type terminology. Later DeviceDefinition work renamed the originally requested deviceIdentifier child to identifier, added identifierSystem, and relaxed type to CodeableConcept/extensible; those are later refinements rather than missing FHIR-34356 work. OO Catalog minutes support the same Basic UDI-DI/master/license mapping.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The published commit is an empty audit commit documenting that the authoritative current source already satisfies FHIR-34356 and that later Jira/source history explains the naming and binding differences from the original request.
